title: Branch radius -> small (r/R = 1e-3), beta = 45: opening tends to an ellipse
derivation: For r << R the header is locally a plane cut obliquely by the branch: an ellipse with semi-axes r/sin(beta) = 1.41421356 along the axis and r = 1 around it. Area -> pi r^2/sin(beta); perimeter -> 4 a E(1 - b^2/a^2). Curvature corrections are O((r/R)^2) = 1e-6 relative; tolerance 2e-4 relative. The station is where the branch axis meets the header axis (work point), so the opening centre on the surface is at station + R/tan(beta) = 1050, on the generator facing the branch (y = pi R).
